headline: Cowboys send Steelers 2027 sixth-round pick and 2028 second-round pick for Joey Porter Jr.
summary: One of the NFL's best young cornerbacks is heading to Dallas, and Pittsburgh is getting two picks.

headline: Falcons sign DT Gervon Dexter Sr. to four-year extension
summary: The Falcons signed Gervon Dexter Sr. to a four-year, $78 million contract extension, sources told ESPN.
